facts.fact: A NITA-U IT professional said on 2026-10-01 that UGHub, a national data integration platform managed by NITA-U, connects NIRA's identity registry to MDAs and private institutions, which verify identities against it in real time.
The same NITA-U speaker said UGHub connects NIRA's registry with more than 150 government ministries, departments and agencies, plus banks and telecoms.
